title: Perimeter in one screen
rememberThis: Security groups: stateful, allow-only, ENI-level — reference ALB SG from app SG.
NACLs: stateless subnet boundary with numbered allow/deny — add ephemeral outbound rules.
ALB for HTTP, NLB for TCP/static IP/PrivateLink, GWLB for inline firewalls.
HTTP API Gateway for most REST; REST API when usage plans/API keys required.
WAF filters HTTP at edge; Shield Standard is free DDoS — not a replacement for WAF or SG.
bullets: 503/502 debug: WAF block → ALB unhealthy target → SG chain → NACL → app.
CloudFront Web ACL uses CLOUDFRONT scope in us-east-1.
API Gateway VPC Link reaches private ALB/NLB — different from public HTTP integration.
Rate-based WAF rules may block carrier-grade NAT users sharing one IP.
Reachability Analyzer validates SG/NACL path without guessing.
